title: Slow motion
summary: Shoot at a high frame rate, play it back slowed down.
steps: Pick the highest frame rate your camera offers.
Set the shutter to about 1/(2 × frame rate).
Use plenty of light: high frame rates need fast shutters.
Pre-focus where the action will happen.
Record a little before and after the moment.

items: Indoor LED and fluorescent lights can flicker at high frame rates. Daylight is safest.

steps: **MENU › Shooting 1 › High Frame Rate › Enable.** It records Full HD at 119.9 fps (or 100 fps in PAL).
Set the shutter to **1/250 s** in movie manual exposure. ISO goes to 12800.
Turn on **Shooting 6 › Zebra settings** to see overexposed areas.
Record. Clips play back at **1/4 speed** straight from the camera.
canon-r10.note: No sound is recorded, and each clip is limited to 30 minutes.

steps: Swipe up from the bottom of the screen and set **4K, 2.7K or 1080p at 16:9 and 100 fps or higher**.
Play the clip back and stop at the moment you want.
Tap the **super slow-motion** icon. The camera makes a 1080p clip slowed down with 4× frame interpolation (up to 960 fps).
Tap Preview to check it. Add up to 6 slow-motion clips per video.
dji-osmo-action-5-pro.note: It can't use the first 1.5 s or the last 2 s of a clip, so start recording early and stop late.
